author: Scarlet Sanctuary
title: Seeking 2D/3D Artist for Game Art
content: I am looking for a 2D /3D artist to do game mesh art and some art in general for some pieces, could pay in royalties depending on talent and what all you offer to the project. Game will be on Google play and Microsoft Store for PC players, free to play with micro transactions, zero ads will be in this game. I suck at drawing my failed attempt at a horse. The base of the game is tower defense with a PVP State vs State online mode, fight to take over other states for its resources in massive battles, using some tower defense, loop hero rouge mixed in with some clash of clans. All battles are done in a tower defense srlye, you build your tower defense base, and other attack it. #gamers #artist
